# Metal's texels of the device checks' fixed random BC6H and BC7 blocks
# (`bind::device_checks::block_decode`), read on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 27.0.1, 26A434) by our own
# probe: a 32x32 texture of the 64 blocks, 8 to a row, each texel read by a kernel's
# `texture2d<float>::read` as `float4`. Two runs gave the same bytes. Every BC6H channel read is a
# `half` widened exactly and every alpha 1.0; every BC7 channel `k / 255` for its 8-bit code `k`,
# correctly rounded to `f32`.
#
# One block per format:
#   format <name>
#   <block, 16 bytes hex> <its 16 texels, row by row, hex>
#     BC6H: each texel's red, green and blue `half`, little-endian (6 bytes);
#     BC7: each texel's red, green, blue and alpha code (4 bytes).
format bc6h_ufloat
